title: gate 5 re-cut: what may leave the box, the cross-path test over every exit

findings.claim: The support bundle as built carries planted names without a label, and identifiers in base64, quoted-printable and the other encoding classes; no member passes prepare_output
A service log longer than the bundle's read limit keeps half a pseudonym cut at that limit (R22-24 item 2, still on master)
The sponsor pack export carries patient text written into an aggregate file or the population field, in clear and in every encoding class
The enrolment report download carries patient text typed as a withdrawal or screen-fail reason; its owner is to be named
Exit sites in the output-sink inventory (console downloads, job files, deliverables, rule-set packages, the test mail sender) have no road in the cross-path test yet
The sink ratchet's ceiling counts the six bundle sites H-71 moved on master as growth, so test_remaining_output_sinks_match_the_inventory cannot pass without a ruling
